system.description:
A seafaring thief built around cargo and quick exits.

  • Smuggler's Stash: On a ship, cart or wagon you find its hidden compartments with 1 minute of searching and no check, and can hide up to 2 slots of goods there that a search finds only by beating your Pick Pocket check.
  • Climbing rigging never needs a check.
  • After your Sneak Attack hits, you can move 10ft as part of the same action without provoking Attacks of Opportunity.
  • Dockside Charm: Advantage on checks bribing or negotiating with port officials.
